title: A Town Has Been on Fire Underground Since 1962

scenes.text: There's an American town that has been on fire for over sixty years.
In 1962, a fire started in an old coal mine under Centralia, Pennsylvania.
It spread through tunnels as deep as 300 feet and covers about 3,700 acres.
Roads cracked open. Smoke and steam rose from the ground.
Almost everyone left. The population dropped from about 1,500 to five.
Experts say it could keep burning for 250 more years.

description:
A coal mine fire under Centralia, Pennsylvania has burned since at least 1962.
It covers about 3,700 acres and is estimated to be able to burn for more than 250 years. Of roughly 1,500 residents when it began, only 5 remained by 2017.
Would you visit a town like this? Comment below.
first_comment: Would you stay in a town where the ground itself is burning? Why or why not?
